title: US markets closed — Thanksgiving Day (the only NYSE closure followed by a scheduled early close, and the repricing lands on Monday 2027-11-29, not on the half day)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this lane's own initial research (HTTP 200 after its 302 — the page needs curl -L — 109,180 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell, 133 cells. The page states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028'; the header row is 'Holiday | 2026 | 2027 | 2028' and the Thanksgiving Day row parses as 'Thursday, November 26***' / 'Thursday, November 25***' / 'Thursday, November 23*** ', so 2027 is a FULL closure on Thursday November 25. Footnote *** reads verbatim: 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Friday, November 27, 2026, Friday, November 26, 2027, and Friday, November 24, 2028 (the day after Thanksgiving).' CORROBORATED FROM THREE FURTHER SOURCES FETCHED THE SAME SESSION, none of which depends on the NYSE page. (1) The OCC's own 2027 expiration calendar (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) marks 2027-11-25 'Exchange/OCC holiday' with hatched:true, its full-closure flag, and marks no other November 2027 date that way. (2) SIFMA's US Holiday Recommendations panel (sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule, HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) gives 'Thanksgiving Day' / 'Thursday, November 25, 2027' / 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, November 26, 2027' for the fixed-income side; panel attribution was verified by the surrounding US-only run (U.S. Independence Day, Labor Day, Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas) and cross-validated against the Memorial Day 2027 card this repo's sifma-bond-early-close-2027-05-28 entry already records verbatim. (3) Statute and weekday arithmetic, computed rather than assumed: 5 U.S.C. 6103 (uscode.house.gov, HTTP 200, 170,743 bytes) reads 'Thanksgiving Day, the fourth Thursday in November'; 2027-11-01 is a Monday, so the November Thursdays are the 4th, 11th, 18th and 25th and the fourth is 2027-11-25. THE RULE WAS ALSO VALIDATED AGAINST THE TAPE, not merely quoted: computing the fourth Thursday of November for 1970-2026 and looking each date up in ^GSPC daily bars returns 0 of 56 trading days. Filed estimate on the two counts every sibling closure entry documents (labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07, good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31, presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15): the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an exchange's own holiday calendar, and a lane may not self-confirm. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-08), per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md's rule for an id that existed only as a sibling's proposal. The one proposal it shadows — proposals/thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25.from-fomc-minutes-2027-11-17.json — was read first and stays where it is; its date argument and its taxonomy reasoning are reproduced above from first-hand fetches rather than inherited, and its claim that this date is the sole non-decision input to the FOMC-minutes publication rule is left to that lane. WHAT THIS ENTRY ADDS BEYOND THE DATE, and why the title says what it does. Thanksgiving is STRUCTURALLY UNIQUE on the NYSE calendar, verifiable straight off the grid above: of the ten holidays listed, it is the only one fixed to a Thursday, and of the three early closes in the footnote list (Monday July 3 2028, the day after Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve 2026) it is the only closure that is FOLLOWED by a scheduled early close — every other early close PRECEDES its holiday. So the closure's first reopening session is 3.5 hours long by rule, and the market's next full session is the Monday. MEASURED CONSEQUENCE (^GSPC daily bars 1970-2025, n=56, and ^VIX 1990-2025, n=36, computed by this lane): the reopening premium every other US closure carries on its FIRST session lands one session LATE here. The half-day Friday runs 0.73x the November baseline in mean absolute S&P move and the Monday runs 1.44x, while Labor Day's reopening is 1.35x and its second session 0.88x, Memorial 1.27x/1.03x, Presidents 1.22x/0.88x, MLK 1.02x/1.03x. Rank-based so the 2008 tail cannot drive it: session 2 out-moves session 1 in 35 of 56 Thanksgivings (62.5%) against 83 of 194 (42.8%) pooled across the four Monday closures, z = 2.60, two-sided p = 0.0092; on VIX the larger step lands on session 2 in 25 of 36 (69.4%) against 67 of 136 (49.3%), z = 2.16, p = 0.031. The TOTAL repricing across the closure is generic (span 1.60x baseline vs Memorial 1.61x, Labor 1.50x) — only its timing differs. WHAT THAT IS AND IS NOT: it is a RELATIVE, ordinal claim about which of two sessions absorbs the gap, not a claim that the Monday is a large session. Against ordinary November Mondays the post-Thanksgiving Monday's MEDIAN is only 1.09x (permutation p = 0.36), so the level claim is refused and only the ordering survives. FOR 2027 SPECIFICALLY: Wednesday 2027-11-24 is a full 09:30-16:00 ET session (the NYSE footnote list carries no Wednesday-before-Thanksgiving early close in any of the three years); Friday 2027-11-26 closes at 13:00 ET for equities and 14:00 ET for bonds, so bonds outlive equities by an hour; the displaced Monday 2027-11-29 sits INSIDE the December FOMC blackout (fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27, estimate; the December 2027 meeting is 12-07/08 per federalreserve.gov's own 2027 calendar, itself marked tentative) and is November's PENULTIMATE session, one session before a month-end Tuesday carrying consumer-confidence-2027-11-30 and fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30. That stack makes 2027-11-29 an ATTRIBUTION TRAP with four competing explanations, which is precisely why it is recorded and not traded. IMPACT low and symbols [] match every sibling closure entry: a closure removes sessions, it does not signal, and a re-grep of docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md this session for holiday|thanksgiving|black friday|half.day|early close|closure|blackout returns ZERO hits in both, so nothing in the house system can fire on this date in either direction. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry. Full ledger: docs/research/events/thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25.md
